title: Hold a food safety scheme licence
what: Carry on a dairy, meat, seafood, egg, plant products or vulnerable persons food business only under a licence from the NSW Food Authority.

sources.title: Food Regulation 2015 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a food business unless the person holds a licence authorising the carrying on of the food business

sources.title: Food Regulation 2015 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: food business means— (a) a dairy business within the meaning of Part 8, or (b) a meat business within the meaning of Part 9, or (c) a plant products business within the meaning of Part 10, or (d) a seafood business within the meaning of Part 11, or (e) a vulnerable persons food business within the meaning of Part 12, or (f) an egg business within the meaning of Part 13

reach.condition: if it is a dairy, meat, seafood, egg, plant products or vulnerable persons food business under the Food Regulation

sources.title: Food Regulation 2015 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a food business unless the person holds a licence authorising the carrying on of the food business

reach.condition: if it produces or grades eggs for sale

sources.title: Food Regulation 2015 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a food business unless the person holds a licence authorising the carrying on of the food business

reach.condition: if it serves food to vulnerable persons (a hospital or aged care facility)
